title: Arroyo Seco Park – CD14 Tiny Homes Village Project – Extension of Emergency
text:
Arroyo Seco Park – CD14 Tiny Homes Village Project – Extension of Emergency
  Use of a Portion of the Park for a Temporary Homeless Shelter Facility for a
  Period Not to Exceed One Year – Statutory Exemption from the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Pursuant to California Public Resources
  Code Section 21080.27.5 and Government Code Section 8698.4(a)(4)
  Applicable to Lease, Conveyance, Encumbrance, Financial Assistance, and
  Contract to Provide Services for People Experiencing Homelessness
summary: Extends for up to one year the use of part of Arroyo Seco Park as a temporary homeless shelter tiny homes village in Council District 14.

details.action: extension of emergency use of park for temporary homeless shelter
